review_evidence: README identifies Aesop as an automated extensible proof-search tactic for Lean, with its production modules implementing rule registration, normalization, search-tree construction, tactic elaboration, and execution.

Declaration scan found 663 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations under AesopTest but only four proposition declarations in production Aesop/, all in BuiltinRules.lean (basic logical helper facts such as not-introduction and HEq/equality conversion).

The large proposition surface is therefore explicitly tactic regression/test workload; the implementation does not provide a separate proved correctness or formal-semantics development for the search procedure.

source_action.content_invariant: Production Aesop code is tactic/search implementation; its only four proposition declarations are elementary builtin-rule helpers, while hundreds of propositions live in AesopTest as regression workloads, so retirement hides no independent mathematical theorem/proof corpus or verified search semantics.
